description: Decides whether the agent may run a tool on its own, must ask a human first, or may not run it at all. With no matching row, every write asks first.

fields.description: The registered tool this rule applies to.
fields.label: Tool

fields.description: Allow runs the tool without asking. Require Approval pauses the run until a human answers. Deny refuses the call and tells the agent why.
fields.label: Mode

fields.description: What happens in a run started by a trigger or a schedule, where nobody is watching. Same as Mode means Require Approval parks the run and raises a to-do for the person it runs as.
fields.label: When Unattended
fields.options:
Same as Mode
Require Approval
Allow
Deny

fields.description: Apply only to users holding this role. Leave empty to apply to everyone.
fields.label: Role

fields.description: Highest priority wins. A rule with a role beats a rule without one at the same priority.
fields.label: Priority

fields.description: Shown to the person approving, or given to the agent as the reason it was refused.
fields.label: Message

name: Sales AI Action Policy
